$comment: Files consumers may vendor under vendor/pawprint/. Bicep has no module registry available here, so sharing means copying; this manifest is what makes the copy auditable rather than folklore. kit-bicep-validate.yml fails a consumer build when a vendored copy drifts from these sources.

files.description: Upstream license and attribution, retained with vendored source.
Canonical Bicep lint and formatting rules.
Resolves config/deploy.config.json into deployment environment variables.
Builds the ID-qualified GitHub Actions OIDC federated-credential subject. The one string every repo's OIDC bootstrap must agree on byte-for-byte, or the trust relationship simply never matches.
Fails on malformed deployment variables before any Azure call is made.
Orchestrates Azure Static Web App domain validation using the shared Cloudflare DNS reconciler.
Shared, ownership-scoped Cloudflare record reconciliation for Azure custom domains and explicitly declared platform records.
Shared-source synchronization and offline verification of content-hashed vendor snapshots.
Reports expired, expiring and unexpiring Key Vault secrets.
Static Web App with an optional DNS-validated custom domain.
Defender for Cloud connector shell for GitHub, Azure DevOps, or GitLab.
RBAC-authorised Key Vault serving either secret tier.
Per-secret read grants, for consumers on the platform secret tier.
Shared types required by vendored infrastructure modules.
Capped Log Analytics workspace and linked Application Insights.
Front Door Premium profile identity, independent of origin routing.
HTTPS Front Door routing, managed WAF, optional benign training marker, and diagnostics.
PHP App Service restricted to a specific Front Door profile, with managed identity and diagnostics.
